title: Know Thyself
intent: Increase accurate self-model so that energy is not wasted on internal contradiction or self-deception.
eta_goal: Higher decision quality and lower internal entropy.
core_framing: Inaccurate self-knowledge produces repeated low-η loops.
Honest inventory of strengths, wounds, patterns, and current capacity is the foundation of all other optimization.
Self-knowledge is measured by predictive accuracy about one’s own future behavior.
optimized_query_patterns: What recurring pattern in my behavior is currently costing the most useful joules?
Where does my self-story diverge from observable results?
verification_notes: Prediction accuracy about personal behavior over 30-day windows.
next_physical_or_action: Record one week of actual time and energy use and compare it to the internal story.
